name: Grant-in-aid (TB)
benefit: 1. The grant-in-aid shall be given in cash or by means of a Bank Draft. 1. The grant-in-aid shall be made subject to the availability of found and cannot be claimed as a matter of right. 1. The amount of grant-in-aid shall be limited to the actual cost of treatment and fare as per the cheapest route available subject to the maximum of ₹ 2500/- per head.
_eligibility_text: 1. Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Castes persons permanently residing within the State of Mizoram 1. None of whose family members are Government employees and whose family income from all sources does not exceed ₹2000/- per month and who suffering from fell diseases are eligible to receive the grant.
